name: Castigate the Faithless AP OLD

stealth.note: (master) or @Check[perception|dc:50] (legendary) to notice the bypass button hidden in Urgathoa's skeletal feet

description: Magic forces those who pass by the statue to the ground with sudden force; pressing the bypass button deactivates the trap for 1 minute.
disable: DC 47 Religion (legendary) to deactivate the trap through prayer, Dispel Magic (8th rank; counteract DC 47) to counteract the trap, or press the bypass button
reset: The trap resets automatically if triggered, after 1 minute if the bypass button is pressed, or after 15 minutes if disabled or counteracted.

generalAbilities.name: Kneel!
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature passes by the statue

Effect The trap deals (7d12+40) Force Damage damage to the triggering creature (Basic DC 46 Reflex Saving Throw). On a failed save, the creature is knocked Prone, and on a critical failure, the creature is knocked prone and takes an additional 1d12 Bludgeoning Damage damage from the force of the fall.
